topic: Computer distance & lighting: arm's length, top of screen at eye level, no glare

youtube.title: Eyes tired by 4 pm? Fix your desk setup 💻 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Eyes tired and heavy by 4 pm? Your desk setup may be the reason.
கணினி திரை ஒரு கை நீளம் தூரத்தில் இருக்கட்டும்.

• Keep the screen about an arm's length away.
• Top of the screen at or just below eye level, so you look slightly down.
• Window to the side, not behind or in front of the screen; keep the room about as bright as the screen.
• Studies show we blink much less while looking at screens, which dries the eyes.
• 20-20-20: every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds, and blink fully.
• Headaches or blur at work may mean you need glasses made for screen distance.

gmb.text: Do your eyes feel tired by late afternoon at work? Your desk setup may be the reason. Keep the screen about an arm's length away, with the top of the screen at or just below eye level so you look slightly down. Place the window to the side, not behind or in front of the screen, and keep the room about as bright as the screen to avoid glare. We blink much less while looking at screens, so follow the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds and blink fully. If headaches or blur continue, you may need glasses made for screen distance. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
